verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail confirms it has its own API for programmatic control of mail workflows. However, the API is gated: documentation is only available on request, there is no public spec, and probes for OpenAPI or llms.txt return 404, so the 'documented public API' part of the story is not met. Missing for 10: public API reference or spec, evidence of endpoints for listing mail items, evidence of endpoints for downloading scan PDFs, sandbox or versioning docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can list mail items and download scans through a documented public API — my systems ingest postal mail like any other data source

citations.quote: If that's not enough, use our API directly to take full control of your workflow.

we do offer an API that you can use. API access is currently available to those who may know how to program or code software. You can contact us to request for developer information on how to access the API.
